MAKE IT YOURS

A starting point. Your own way forward.

Use the public tool to explore. Your private account holds your own wedding details.

01

Begin with your priorities

Decide what you can comfortably spend before comparing quotes. Include contributions only when they are confirmed, and keep an allowance for unexpected costs.

02

Compare the full picture

Check what each quote includes: service hours, delivery, setup, pack-down, travel, minimum numbers and any other stated charges. Record confirmed costs separately from your early estimates.

03

Keep payments visible

Inside your account, record the total paid so far and each due date. Your dashboard separates what you expect to spend, what you have paid and what remains, including overdue amounts.
